measures.title: Charter Amendment Requiring County Commissioner District Town Hall Meetings
measures.summary: Proposed by the Clallam County Charter Review Commission, this would amend Article II of the County Charter. Each commissioner would have to hold at least one town hall meeting per year in their own commissioner district, and the commissioners together would have to hold at least one town hall meeting per year in each of the three districts. The meetings would be held outside normal business hours with at least 30 days' notice.
measures.yesMeans: The Charter would require annual commissioner town hall meetings in each commissioner district outside normal business hours.
measures.noMeans: The Charter would not add a town hall meeting requirement.

measures.title: Charter Amendment Establishing an Ethics Review Board
measures.summary: Proposed by the Clallam County Charter Review Commission, this would amend Article VIII of the County Charter to create a three-member ethics review board, one member from each commissioner district, to review complaints that elected county officials violated the county code of ethics. Members would be appointed by designated independently elected county officials and serve unpaid staggered three-year terms. The board would issue written findings posted on the county website but would not impose penalties.
measures.yesMeans: The Charter would establish an ethics review board to review complaints against elected county officials and publish its findings.
measures.noMeans: The Charter would not establish an ethics review board.

measures.title: Charter Amendment Requiring Printing of the Full Text of Proposed Charter Amendments in the Local Voters' Pamphlet
measures.summary: Proposed by the Clallam County Charter Review Commission, this would amend Article XI of the County Charter. It would require the full text of every proposed charter amendment to be printed in the local voters' pamphlet, similar to how statewide initiatives appear in the state voters' pamphlet.
measures.yesMeans: The full text of future proposed charter amendments would have to be printed in the local voters' pamphlet.
measures.noMeans: The Charter's current voters' pamphlet printing requirement would stay as it is.
